newsitem.title: FINLAND: EFORE PROPOSES ONE FOR 10 BONUS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: EFORE PROPOSES ONE FOR 10 BONUS ISSUE.

text.p: Finnish electronics component maker Efore Oy said on Tuesday its board would propose a one for ten bonus issue.
"The board proposes ... a bonus issue giving one new share free of charge for every ten old shares," Efore said in a statement with its 12-month report.
Efore also said its board had proposed a 4.00 markka dividend per share for the financial year to end-October, down from the previous year's 8.00 markka.
Efore's 12-month profit before extraordinary items fell to 4.19 million markka from 19.12 million.
